question: Does left-applying non-uniform scale to a rotation matrix produce the same transform as local right-applied scale for the values used by the Godot AnimationPlayer regression probe?

sources.title: Godot core/math/basis.cpp
sources.supported_claim: Basis::scale/ scaled left-multiply by scale while scale_local/scaled_local right-multiply by scale.

sources.title: Godot scene/3d/node_3d.cpp
sources.supported_claim: Node3D stores rotation and scale separately and rebuilds the local basis through set_euler_scale when the local transform is requested.

expected_observations.left_differs_from_right: supports the hypothesis that the two Godot code paths apply distinct transform semantics under rotation plus non-uniform scale

stop_condition: Record whether the two matrices differ for the target fixture and preserve the numeric distance; do not infer target runtime behavior from the model alone.
